constructed_source.description: Constructed RTL-physical co-design benchmark around the BlackParrot front-end instruction cache (bp_fe_icache.sv): code/bp_sram_256x128.sv maps each 256x128 bank cluster to two characterized IHP SG13G2 RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x64_c2_bm_bist SRAM macro cuts (i_cut_low and i_cut_high), and code/banked.sv implements a 4-cluster 128-bit subword byte-reverse/XOR relay and byte-enable network across 8 SRAM macros placed in a two-bay OpenROAD floorplan (plan/placement.json).

oracle: Icarus Verilog functional simulation of four-cluster 128-bit SRAM subword byte-reverse/XOR relay, Yosys/Slang synthesis to 8 RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x64_c2_bm_bist macros, and OpenROAD floorplanning, PDN, placement, CTS, global routing, and propagated STA.
